memoryPolicyChange: Host free-memory floor strengthened from 2 to 8 GiB: conservatively reserve the new 6-GiB allocation plus 2 GiB host margin; free WSL virtual pages need not be physically resident. This is a safety reservation, not a vendor minimum.
limits: One bounded pause/unreachability case on one disposable worker; not disk loss, hard power failure, or long-eviction acceptance.
180-second independent polling watchdog requests resume, but external Docker/host failure can prevent cleanup; such a case must FAIL.
Stateless rescheduling and read-only contradictory-local-PV-affinity refusal are distinct. No stateful migration or forced pod/PVC deletion.
No writes during outage. Prior committed transactions and new authenticated API transactions/ledger convergence are required after original worker returns.
Healthy mTLS participation membership/height is checked during outage; leader identity/election latency and commit availability during outage are not qualified.
Single-PC kind does not establish independent physical-host resilience or disaster recovery.
Native API listener ownership attestation currently supports Windows; other host platforms fail closed.

credentialScan.scope: Current tracked/untracked source and public evidence; no historical-key remediation claim
